unit: second of the job's source selection (or of the clip asked for; for video-extend, of the added part only), rounded up; Higgsfield's standard self-serve rates, no discount running on 2026-11-14
unpriced: null where no page states the rate at that resolution: the job shows 'Price unknown' until the server's estimate for the uploaded files
upTo: {"upTo": rate} where a page gives only a range over all settings: the top of the range, so the price is never shown lower than it can be; the job shows 'up to' that price until the server's estimate for the uploaded files
